q: The Lott–Sturm–Villani theory defines a synthetic Ricci curvature ≥K for metric measure spaces via:
opts: K-displacement convexity of the Boltzmann entropy in Wasserstein space
exp: LSV: a smooth Riemannian manifold has Ric≥K iff the Boltzmann entropy S(μ)=∫ρlog ρ dx is K-displacement convex in (𝒫₂(M),W₂). This gives a synthetic definition of Ric≥K for non-smooth spaces (graphs, fractals) where classical Riemann curvature is undefined.
